title: Stroke risk study based on deep learning-based magnetic resonance imaging carotid plaque automatic segmentation algorithm
summary: Transfer-learned YOLOv3, RCNN and MobileNet segmented/detected carotid plaque in MRI; reported test/validation performance included 94.81%, 92.53% and 90.23% accuracy with sensitivity/specificity assessment. Full-text Methods and Results were checked; the AI operation, first result-bearing version, measured result and validation are confirmed, with no catalog or lane duplicate. Original Results report held-out, independent, external, cross-fold, or biological validation as applicable; limitations remain bounded to the reported study design.
